note: Rules for words that go out to real people. level block means Meldmind will not send it. level warn means the person sees the reason and may press Send anyway. creditOnly rules apply only when the text is about credit repair. Add a pack by dropping another .json file here.

rules.plain: This promises that items will be deleted or removed.
rules.why: Nobody can promise a deletion. Federal credit repair law (CROA) and California law forbid it. Say what you will do, not what the bureaus will do.

rules.plain: This says you will remove negative items.
rules.why: A credit repair company cannot promise to remove accurate items. Say you will review and dispute what is wrong or unverified.

rules.plain: This asks for payment before the work is done.
rules.why: Credit repair companies may not charge before the service is fully performed (CROA and California law).

rules.plain: This names a number of credit score points.
rules.why: Results vary. A promised score gain can be a misleading claim. Take the number out or say results vary.
A guarantee is a legal promise. Make sure you can keep it, or say what you really offer.

rules.pattern: \b(?:no (?:kids|children)|adults only|(?:perfect|ideal|great) for (?:young|single|married|retired) (?:couples?|professionals?|people|families)|families with (?:young )?children|(?:safe|exclusive|desirable) (?:neighbou?rhood|area)|english[- ]speaking only|walking distance to (?:church|temple|mosque|synagogue)|(?:christian|jewish|muslim|white|black|hispanic|asian) (?:only|preferred|community|neighbou?rhood|buyers?|families))\b
rules.plain: This wording about who the home or area is for can break fair housing rules.
rules.why: Federal fair housing law bars ads that prefer or limit people by race, religion, family status, disability or national origin. Describe the home, not the people.

rules.plain: This names a rate, a payment or a down payment.
rules.why: When a loan ad states one rate or payment, Regulation Z (and TILA) can require the other terms to be shown too. Ask your compliance contact or add the full terms.

rules.plain: There is a leftover placeholder such as [NAME] in the message.
rules.why: People would see the placeholder text itself. Replace it before sending.
